import pyscf
print('PySCF version:',pyscf.__version__)
from pyscf import gto,dft
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('O=CC1NC(C=O)C=C1'))
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=17
assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p)==0
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=500)
c=m.GetConformer()
atoms=[(a.GetSymbol(),tuple(c.GetAtomPosition(i))) for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms())]
mol=gto.M(atom=atoms,basis='def2-svp',charge=0,spin=0,unit='Angstrom',verbose=0)
calc=dft.RKS(mol); calc.xc='b3lyp'; calc.conv_tol=1e-9; calc.max_cycle=150
energy=calc.kernel()
print('SCF converged:',calc.converged,'total energy Ha:',energy)
moe=np.asarray(calc.mo_energy); occ=np.asarray(calc.mo_occ)
homo=float(moe[np.where(occ>0)[0][-1]])
lumo=float(moe[np.where(occ==0)[0][0]])
print('HOMO Ha:',f'{homo:.8f}')
print('LUMO Ha:',f'{lumo:.8f}')
print('HOMO-LUMO gap Ha:',f'{lumo-homo:.8f}')
print('basis: def2-SVP; functional: B3LYP; geometry: RDKit ETKDG + MMFF optimized')
